name: Website Ventures Client Config Contract
purpose: Keep client identity, copy, theme and service content outside reusable customer template markup so fulfilment becomes configuration + real assets + QA rather than rebuilding from zero.

supported.services: Array of up to six {title, description, label}

bindingRules: data-wv-bind replaces textContent only; config text is not inserted as raw HTML.
data-wv-href accepts only # anchors, tel:, mailto:, http:// or https://.
Theme variables are allowlisted; arbitrary CSS variable names are not accepted.
Every repo or local-draft config must pass website-ventures-client-contract.js before any field is applied.
Missing, partial or invalid config is rejected as a whole and retains the hardcoded template fallback.
Real client proof, reviews, certifications and project images remain outside generated demo claims and must be sourced from the client.
fulfilmentIntent: Replace brand, offer copy, contact details, service list and accent theme.
Add approved real client photos/proof and any selected reusable visual assets.
Only then connect the customer's domain/hosting flow.
